simplesect.para: This class stores its values internally in big-endian form and that internal representation is part of the binary protocol of the XRP Ledger and cannot be changed arbitrarily without causing breakage.

parameterdescription.para: The number of bits this integer should have; must be at least 64 and a multiple of 32.
